title: DirecSun wire protocol, version 1
description: Every JSON text frame exchanged between the DirecSun box and a ground station over the WebSocket on port 80 at path /ws: ws://direcsun.local/ws in station mode, ws://192.168.4.1/ws in SoftAP mode, matching the main UI in frontend/. Source of truth for the prose in docs/firmware-design.md section 15; a disagreement between the two is a bug in whichever changed last. Units: angles in degrees, rates in deg/s, wheel speed in rpm, torque in mN m, voltage in V, box time in ms since boot. Wire frame: every quantity about the spin axis (heading, heading reference, magnetometer heading, sun angle, box rate, torque on the box) is clockwise positive seen from above, matching the main UI ("rotate right" is +90 degrees). The firmware computes in the counter-clockwise frame of FD section 2.3 and converts only when it encodes or decodes a message.

v.description: Schema version. Additive, backward-compatible changes stay 1; breaking changes (renamed or removed fields, changed types, units, or meaning) bump it (CONTEXT.md, 2026-10-10).

seq.description: The sender's own message counter, except in ack, where it echoes the command's seq (FD finding V-14).

angle_deg.description: Wrapped angle in (-180, 180] degrees, clockwise positive seen from above (wire frame).

mode.description: Wire mode names (FD section 2.4). BOOT never appears on the wire: comms starts after the control task enters SAFE.

commandable_mode.description: Targets of cmd mode. SAFE is reached with disarm or estop, SPINUP with arm or respin.

interlock.description: Interlock names on the wire (FD section 14.1). MOMENTUM_NEAR_LIMIT is a warning flag, not an interlock trip.

throttle.description: DShot value: 0 is disarm, 48..2047 is throttle. 1..47 are ESC commands that flight code never sends (FD section 21 rule 1).

tlm.description: Telemetry, box to all clients at 50 Hz (FD section 15.3). Every documented field is always present; values the box cannot provide are null.

manual_input.description: Active MANUAL input; null in every other mode.

psi_ref_deg.description: Current heading reference, clockwise positive; null in SAFE, SPINUP, READY, DETUMBLE.

rate_dps.description: Estimated box rate, deg/s, clockwise positive.

mag_deg.description: Magnetometer heading, clockwise positive; null if the magnetometer is missing.

sun_deg.description: Calibrated sun angle, degrees, clockwise positive.

wheel_rpm.description: Wheel speed (interlock estimate speed_safe), rpm, forward direction.

tau_cmd_mNm.description: Commanded torque on the box, mN m, clockwise positive.

loop_us.description: Longest control tick in the last 20 ms, us.

flags.description: Warning flags and latched fault names.

t_c.description: BMP280 temperature, degrees C; null without a BMP280.

p_pa.description: BMP280 pressure, Pa; null without a BMP280.

accel_rms_g.description: Bench mode only (T-7): accelerometer RMS on the avionics deck, g.

gyro_raw.description: Bench mode only (T-8): raw MPU-6050 gyro X, Y, Z counts, in the sensor's own axes (not converted to the wire frame).

mag_raw.description: Bench mode only (T-9): raw QMC5883P X, Y, Z counts, before the axis map and in the sensor's own axes (not converted to the wire frame).

sun_a_mv.description: Bench mode only (T-10): sun sensor A, mV.

sun_b_mv.description: Bench mode only (T-10): sun sensor B, mV.

cmd.description: Command, client to box (FD section 15.3). The box answers every cmd with an ack carrying the same seq.

cmd_bare.description: arm (SAFE to SPINUP; the sender becomes the controlling client), disarm (ramp-down to SAFE without the ESTOP latch), estop (any state, any client), zero_heading (SAFE, READY).

cmd_mode.description: Mode change. psi_ref_deg is required for SLEW and forbidden otherwise; input is required for MANUAL and forbidden otherwise.

psi_ref_deg.description: Absolute SLEW target, clockwise positive; the box takes the shortest wrapped path.

cmd_manual.description: MANUAL setpoint (FD section 13.5): exactly one of throttle, wheel_rpm, rate_dps, matching the active input. The box clamps it, refuses one within 50 ms of the previous accepted one, and counts it as a heartbeat.

throttle.description: Open-loop DShot throttle; the box clamps it to [manual_throttle_min, manual_throttle_max].

wheel_rpm.description: Wheel speed target; the box clamps it to [omega_low, omega_cap].

rate_dps.description: Box rate target, clockwise positive; the box clamps it to +-90 deg/s.

cmd_respin.description: READY to SPINUP with a new wheel start speed (desaturation, FD section 13.4). Default is the bias speed; the box accepts [omega_low + 200, omega_cap - 200].

cmd_set_params.description: SAFE only. The box validates every key and range, stores the set in NVS, and returns the applied set in the ack. omega_cap_rpm and the Wi-Fi settings can never be set over the wire, so they are not accepted here.

cmd_wheel_step.description: Bench only: step the wheel speed reference from READY with bench_mode set; interlocks stay active.

params.description: Parameters of FD section 16. Ranges that depend on other parameters (bias between the limits, a monotonic feed-forward table, min below max) are checked by the box, not here.

ff_table.description: Steady-state throttle versus wheel speed, 8 points from T-5 and T-18, increasing in rpm.

mag_axis_map.description: Box X, Y, Z in terms of sensor axes; default ["+x", "-y", "-z"] for the flipped top deck (FD section 10.2).

mag_cal.description: Hard-iron offset (3 values, counts) and the 2 x 2 soft-iron matrix for the horizontal plane (FD section 11.3).

sun_cal.description: Piecewise-linear map from the normalised difference d = (A - B)/(A + B) to sun angle, from T-10.

light_threshold.description: Minimum A + B for a valid sun angle, mV.

ack.description: Box to the sender of a cmd. seq echoes the command's seq. ok:false carries the reason, for example "busy", "too large", "too fast", "not controlling client", "input not available", or a failed guard.

applied.description: set_params only: the parameter set the box applied.

ping.description: Client heartbeat at 5 Hz. Only the controlling client's pings keep an armed box alive (FD section 14.4).

t_client_ms.description: Client clock, echoed in the pong for round-trip time.

ping_seq.description: seq of the ping being answered.

event.description: Box to all clients, on every mode change (including every interlock trip, which changes the mode to SAFE) and on notices.

cause.description: An interlock name, the command that caused the change, or an automatic transition.

name.description: PARAMS_RESET: NVS parameters had a stale version and the defaults were loaded (FD section 16).
